Built a complete bookmark-management app with:

- Search, collections, favorites, and unread filters
- Grid and list layouts
- Add, edit, and delete workflows
- Favorite and read-status controls
- Persistent browser storage
- Responsive mobile design
- Polished editorial visual system and empty states

The production build succeeds, the app responds on port 4000, and desktop/mobile rendering was browser-checked.

Open it at **http://maker:4000**.
